item.title: Cardinals Müller, Sarah urge SSPX to submit to papal authority
item.description: "The only solution possible in conscience before God is for the Society of St. Pius X … to recognize our Holy Father Pope Leo XIV as the legitimate Pope not only in theory but also in practice, and to submit to his teaching authority and his primacy of jurisdiction without preconditions," wrote Cardinal Gerhard Müller. The post Cardinals Müller, Sarah urge SSPX to submit to papal authority appeared first on America Magazine.

item.title: Mexico burns after drug cartel leader is captured and killed
item.description: Mexico exploded in violence after special forces killed drug cartel leader Nemesio “El Mencho” Oseguera, leader of the fearsome Jalisco New Generation Cartel. Its foot soldiers fanned out across 20 states, burning vehicles and buildings in attacks claiming at least 70 lives, including 25 National Guard members.
